sentences.text:
===
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr Hemant Kumar, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr Rabindra Kumar, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr Justice Prabhat Kumar Singh
 Oral Order
4 18-08-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned APP.
2 The petitioner apprehends arrest in Complaint Case No 475 of 2021 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 379/34 of Indian Penal Code and Sections  of Dowry Prohibition Act.
3 As per the prosecution case, the petitioner along with other accused persons tortured the complainant and ousted her due to non-fulfillment of demand of dowry.
4 Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the dispute has been settled through mediation.

5 Learned counsel for Opposite Party No 2 and Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.15534 of 2023(4)
dt.18-08-2023 learned APP do not dispute the submission made on behalf of the petitioner.
6 Considering the above submissions, in the event of arrest/surrender within a period of six weeks from today, the petitioner above named be enlarged on bail on his furnishing bonds of Rs 10,000/-
